plugin_desc: Transition Networks (now Lantronix) switch / managed media-converter SNMP collection (IANA PEN 868). Interface traffic is supplied by the shared Switch SNMP IF-MIB floor. Proven private device-health objects are CPU temperature in degrees Celsius (tnDevSysHwInforCPUtmp, table). Optional board temperature (tnDevSysHwInforBoardtmp) is collected when the device returns it. CPU and memory utilization are not collected because no private CPU or memory utilization object is published. Fan and power-supply state are not collected. Supported brands/models — Transition Networks SISPM/SM hardened managed switches and ION/IONMM managed media converters.
name: Switch

metrics.name: cpu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: CPU temperature of the Transition Networks switch in degrees Celsius (tnDevSysHwInforCPUtmp, table). Aggregated as the maximum across hardware-info rows. Abnormally high values may indicate blocked airflow, failing cooling, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Optional board temperature of the Transition Networks switch in degrees Celsius (tnDevSysHwInforBoardtmp, table). Aggregated as the maximum across hardware-info rows when the device returns the column. Some models omit this object; missing rows are skipped. High readings may indicate blocked airflow or excessive ambient heat.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
